text: A letter arrives: an old friend from your younger days has passed away.

outcomes.text: You stand at the grave and say the words you never said in life.
You pour a cup of wine to the empty chair.

text: On a quiet night you sit on your porch and count the years behind you.

outcomes.text: A long breath, and a long-held weight falls from you.

choices.label: Resolve to cultivate harder than ever

outcomes.text: A fire kindles in your dantian that had gone dim for decades.
The old body protests, and you push too hard.

text: In the deep of night you see the faces of those you have lost, calm, patient, waiting.

outcomes.text: A warmth fills you. Whatever comes will come in its own time.

choices.label: Burn your qi to cling to life

outcomes.text: You shake off the shadow and add years to your life.
The visions only grow stronger.

text: In a dream, a figure with your family's eyes teaches you a technique, one breath at a time.

outcomes.text: You wake with a technique firmly in your mind.
You remember only fragments, but they help.

text: In the attic of the old house, you find a chest your ancestors wrapped in cloth and wax.

outcomes.text: Inside is a ring that hums softly when you put it on.
A small purse of old coins and a letter of blessing.
Only dust and a lock of hair.

text: Your grown child tells you they wish to leave to see the world and test their own strength.

choices.label: Give them money and your blessing (40 gold)

outcomes.text: They hug you tightly and set off with a heavy pack.
They set off with an empty purse and a full heart.
They stay, and the house is warm, but something unspoken remains.

text: Your dao companion proposes you cultivate side by side for a year, each guiding the other's qi.

outcomes.text: Your qi cycles beautifully with theirs.
A small misstep causes a backlash.
They nod, but their smile is thin.

text: Today marks another year since you and your partner first met.

outcomes.text: Their eyes shine. The evening is warm.
The meal is surprisingly good.
The meal is a disaster, but you laugh together.
Their silence is louder than words.

text: Your child comes home with a bruised face. Disciples of a rival sect have been picking on them.

outcomes.text: A single stern conversation ends the trouble.
The fight escalates and you are the one hurt.

choices.label: Teach your child to defend themselves

outcomes.text: Weeks of practice turn a victim into a fighter.
